channel.title: PI Probaligence News
channel.description: Company news and evergreen guides on surrogate modeling, coating development, and chemical process scale-up, written to explain the methods plainly.

item.title: Kevin Cremanns co-authors new book on AI in product development
item.description: Kevin Cremanns co-authored KI in der Produktentwicklung, a 226 page technical book on applying AI in engineering, published by Vogel Professional Education in July 2026.

item.title: PI Probaligence is an official NAFEMS member
item.description: PI Probaligence is an official member of NAFEMS, the international association for the engineering modelling, analysis and simulation community.

item.title: CADFEM Conference Rapperswil, Switzerland 2026
item.description: PI Probaligence joined the CADFEM Conference Rapperswil 2026 as exhibitor and speaker, showing STOCHOS Flow and projects with VAT and Jaeger-LeCoultre.

item.title: PI Probaligence at the CADFEM AI Conference Singapore 2026
item.description: Over 100 engineers and researchers discussed practical AI in engineering at the CADFEM AI Conference Singapore 2026, with STOCHOS on the agenda.

item.title: Discover STOCHOS Flow: free online seminar
item.description: Two free one-hour webinars on 23 and 24 June 2026 introduce STOCHOS Flow for chemistry and engineering applications, in English on Microsoft Teams.

item.title: First prize at the Robert Bosch Foundation Health Award
item.description: A joint project on AI-supported prevention of diabetic foot syndrome won the Ideas for Impact Health Prize; PI Probaligence built the core AI technology.

item.title: Introducing STOCHOS Flow: AI-assisted workflow automation for engineers
item.description: STOCHOS Flow is a visual workflow editor with a built-in AI agent that creates nodes, wires workflows, and runs fully locally: no cloud, no data leakage.

item.title: PI Probaligence achieves official Ansys Technology Partner status
item.description: PI Probaligence achieved official Ansys Technology Partner status on 25 November 2025, after developing AI algorithms for the Ansys ecosystem since 2022.

item.title: Article in Konstruktionspraxis: Automated Verification Processes at GEMÜ with STOCHOS
item.description: Konstruktionspraxis reports how GEMÜ automates strength verification of metallic valve bodies with STOCHOS and CADFEM, cutting manual modeling effort.

item.title: PI Probaligence Visits CADFEM SEA in Singapore
item.description: Kevin Cremanns visited Singapore with CADFEM South East Asia for joint customer meetings on STOCHOS and advanced engineering simulation applications.

item.title: PI Probaligence Joins Lacktagung 2025 in Aachen, Germany
item.description: PI Probaligence joined the GDCh Coatings Conference 2025 in Aachen with a talk and booth on AI-driven adaptive design of experiments for coatings development.

item.title: PI Probaligence at the CADFEM Konferenz 2025 in Rapperswil
item.description: PI Probaligence presented generative AI for engineering and a first look at its new graphical user interface at the CADFEM Konferenz 2025 in Rapperswil.

item.title: AI Beyond the Buzz: How Engineers Apply AI in Real-World Projects
item.description: Kevin Cremanns and APC's Ana Luisa Pinto Queiroz discuss a STOCHOS gene therapy case in CADFEM's Blueprint interview: weeks of computing cut with multi-fidelity.

item.title: New Office in the CADFEM Building
item.description: PI Probaligence moved into its new office in the CADFEM building in Grafing near Munich on 1 July 2025, about 30 minutes by train from Munich East Station.

item.title: High Fidelity Digital Twins Using AI
item.description: PI Probaligence, SGL Carbon, and DLR cut multi-scale composite simulation from months to minutes with STOCHOS material models in macro-level FEM.

item.title: PI at the CADFEM Conference France 2025
item.description: PI presented its AI tools for simulation engineers at the CADFEM Conference France 2025 in Lyon on June 4, alongside companies serving Ansys users.

item.title: Case study: multifidelity analysis of a traversed induction hardening device
item.description: 20 high-fidelity plus 69 low-fidelity simulations trained one model that predicts peak temperatures accurately; low-fidelity alone erred by up to 40%.

item.title: AI in coatings development: insights from ECS 2025
item.description: PI at the European Coatings Show 2025: automated design of experiments and AI control of high-throughput experimentation drew the strongest interest.

item.title: Our interview in the expert survey: How AI is revolutionizing production
item.description: PI's answers in the Digital Manufacturing expert survey: where AI already works in production today and which hurdles slow wider adoption.

item.title: PI Probaligence expands its presence in the USA
item.description: Dr. Cremanns presented the new STOCHOS features at OzenCon 2025 by Ozen Engineering in San Jose, USA, and met with customers about upcoming projects.

item.title: Making repositories and AI systems usable in everyday nursing care (KIP)
item.description: In the KIP healthcare program, PI built AI software that reads a pressure sensor in a shoe and warns diabetic foot syndrome patients in real time by smartwatch.

item.title: STOCHOS 6.0.0 released
item.description: STOCHOS 6.0.0 adds GEN-AI geometry generation, one-line web app export for DIM-GP models, target-driven sensitivity analysis, and a text-based optimization API.

item.title: CADFEM Conference 2024 Austria
item.description: Dr. Cremanns presented PI's latest developments to around 200 attendees at the CADFEM Simulation Conference Austria in Salzburg on 7 November 2024.

item.title: WOST Conference 2024
item.description: With AI as a focus of the WOST Conference 2024, PI Probaligence was invited to present its recent machine learning developments.

item.title: Days of Digital Technologies, 07.-08. October in Berlin
item.description: PI Probaligence presented the Na, Logisch project on sustainable, AI-supported paint development at the Days of Digital Technologies 2024 in Berlin.

item.title: PI Probaligence: From AI startup to a global player
item.description: How PI Probaligence grew from AI startup to CADFEM Group member with projects in Europe, the USA, India, and Southeast Asia. By Nils Odenthal, Managing Director.

item.title: CADFEM Blueprint about AI: Answers to open questions
item.description: CADFEM's Let's Simulate Blueprint series shows how automated Ansys processes generate high-quality simulation training data for AI models. In German.

item.title: The resource-efficient advantages of the probabilistic machine learning software STOCHOS for dedicated simulation applications
item.description: ASCS Magazin 2024 (p. 32-33) features PI Probaligence on the resource-efficient advantages of the probabilistic ML software STOCHOS for simulation.

item.title: PI to attend the European Automotive & Plastic Coating Event
item.description: PI presents AI in industrial painting at the DFO European Automotive & Plastic Coating Event: the Na, Logisch project on data-efficient paint development.

item.title: PI Probaligence participated in the 2nd Workference for Smart Paint
item.description: As a Smart Paint Factory Alliance member, PI Probaligence joined the 2nd Workference at Fraunhofer IFAM Bremen on June 13 and 14, 2024 on AI in paint R&D.

item.title: BioTechX webinar in partnership with Ansys
item.description: Dr. Dmitrij Ivanov of PI Probaligence joins a BioTechX webinar with Ansys on June 19, 2024 on in silico technologies and AI for pharmaceutical applications.

item.title: 'Universal machine learning based on probabilistic intelligence' at the CADFEM Conference 2024 in Rapperswil, Switzerland
item.description: PI Probaligence presents STOCHOS and DIM-GP at the CADFEM Conference 2024 in Rapperswil on June 20: sample-efficient machine learning for R&D experts.

item.title: Read our article 'AI for Engineering' in the engineering journal Der Konstrukteur
item.description: The engineering journal Der Konstrukteur published PI Probaligence's article AI for Engineering in its June 2024 issue, on ML for design optimization.

item.title: Very strong interest in our ML solution at the CADFEM Conference 2024
item.description: PI Probaligence drew strong interest at the CADFEM Conference 2024 in Darmstadt, with new project prospects in automotive, engineering, and process design.

item.title: DLR to present the partner project with SGL Carbon and PI Probaligence at the DPG Annual Conference and Spring Meeting
item.description: DLR presents the joint project with SGL Carbon and PI Probaligence at the DPG Spring Meeting: machine learning replaces microscale FEM for graphite-resin composites.

item.title: PI Probaligence to present at the High Performance Engineering Solutions 2024 in Brasov, Romania
item.description: PI Probaligence joins the High Performance Engineering Solutions 2024 event by INAS in Brasov, Romania, presenting AI engineering solutions.

item.title: Project meeting with the project partners at the Fraunhofer Institute in Bremen
item.description: Na, Logisch project partners met at Fraunhofer in Bremen: building a digital paint twin to cut paint waste, reject rates, and development times.

item.title: PI Probaligence becomes part of the CADFEM Group
item.description: The CADFEM Group acquired a stake in PI Probaligence in January 2024, adding AI expertise and STOCHOS to its simulation solution partner network.

item.title: STOCHOS 5.0.2 released: almost 50% speed boost with backend software upgrade
item.description: STOCHOS 5.0.2 brings a backend software upgrade with roughly 30 to 50% faster processing. Models from the old backend can be reloaded.

item.title: We at PI believe that highly effective, specialized AI solutions for specific problems are the way to go
item.description: Citing MIT Technology Review on the energy cost of generative AI, PI makes the case for specialized, efficient, problem-specific AI models.

item.title: How ZF Friedrichshafen benchmarked PI-BO against Latin hypercube sampling
item.description: ZF Friedrichshafen benchmarked PI-BO against Latin hypercube sampling at NAFEMS 2023: R squared 0.82 against 0.49 at 94 parameters, same sample count.

item.title: Green Tech kick-off event for project Na, Logisch
item.description: Official Berlin kick-off of the BMWK Green Tech Innovation Competition: PI Probaligence partners in Na, Logisch for AI-driven sustainable paint development.

item.title: Results after four adaptations with partner Adler Lacke
item.description: PI Probaligence and ADLER-Werk Lackfabrik matched paint colors in four ML adaptations, close to and partly better than commercial color matching software.
